caption: The drawing features a single object: a child's dress displayed against a plain, off-white background. The dress is knee-length with a fitted bodice, a flared skirt, and three-quarter length sleeves. The fabric has a plaid pattern primarily in shades of blue, green, black, and white. The dress is detailed with a pointed collar and a row of blue buttons running down the front. Darker blue geometric bands with triangular or zigzag patterns accent the sleeves near the edges and encircle the lower portion of the skirt, as well as the button strip running vertically on the bodice and skirt. The dress is depicted with subtle shadowing, giving it a lightly three-dimensional appearance on the flat, neutral canvas.
title: Child's Dress
